subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw bless `YYYY-MM-DD_<UTC>` as the persisted reset/delete archive filename shape for configured `agents.defaults.userTimezone`, with QMD/session-memory consumers required to support it before merge?
rationale: Archive filenames are persisted user-visible session artifacts and current docs do not define `userTimezone` as an archive filename surface, so the compatibility contract needs maintainer intent rather than an automated code-only choice.

options.title: Require full prefixed-contract support
options.body: Accept the prefix direction only if QMD/session-memory readers, cleanup, usage accounting, old-format compatibility, and real configured reset/delete proof are all covered before merge.

options.title: Accept reset/delete prefix only
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge the narrower basename change and defer QMD handling, but that leaves a known archive-hit resolution gap for prefixed exports.

options.title: Pause filename policy
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open and pause this PR until a different archive filename or metadata/display design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Require full prefixed-contract support
recommendation.body: Accept the prefix direction only if QMD/session-memory readers, cleanup, usage accounting, old-format compatibility, and real configured reset/delete proof are all covered before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties jalehman to both the reset/delete lifecycle seam and the SDK transcript identity path affected by the filename contract.
